title: Watch Your Language: Investigating Content Moderation with Large Language Models
measurement_description: The paper did not systematically measure or evaluate any aspect of faith/religion. It used a single comment containing the word 'Jew' as a qualitative example of a false positive in a hate speech detection task, as part of a broader analysis of content moderation errors.
findings: No specific findings related to religion were presented as it was not a focus of the study. A single comment mentioning 'Jew' was used as an example of a model error (false positive) in hate speech moderation, illustrating the model's difficulty with context.
